Method of Attack: Creating specially crafted downloads that crash Windows 10 by accessing the path \\.\globalroot\device\condrv\kernelconnect without required 'attach' extended attribute, causing a blue screen of death (BSOD).
Exploitation via web-based attack by hosting or leveraging a compromised website containing a specially crafted file designed to exploit the vulnerability.
Using browser address bar, assigning path to drive letter using 'net use', or creating specially crafted URL files to trigger crash.
Forcing system crash to hide activities after breaching a system.
Attack Vector: Opening specially crafted downloads or files in Windows 10 folder.
User clicking a link in email or instant messenger leading to specially crafted file.
Accessing vulnerable path via browser or command line.
